text:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 - Serving latency spike for hosted /generate started 2026-03-10 09:22 UTC. Affected: multiple hosted customers. Paging oncall: sylvie-oncall.

sylvie (Oncall): I'm on it. seeing GPU OOMs in pool-12, k8s restarts.

emily-ops: joining. correlating with autoscaler change from earlier deploy.

sylvie (Oncall): Mitigation: rolled back autoscaler config + reduced batch_size. Latency returning to normal. Marking mitigated; monitoring for 15m.

matt (Product): Do we have customer impact window?

sylvie (Oncall): Impact window 09:22–09:37 UTC. Some requests saw 503s and 95p latency spike >2s. Likely SLO breach for hosted customers. Recommend SLA credit check.

jordan-se (Support): Please compile affected customers list. Need proposed customer notification text.

sylvie (Oncall): @billing-ops can you run eligibility calc? Rule: sustained errors >5% or service degradation >10 minutes => credit. Provide amounts per customer and confirm with finance.

billing-ops: Will compute. Pulling logs for customer buckets now. Expect numbers in ~30m.

emily-ops: Draft notification (below):

```
Hi <Customer>,

We experienced a service disruption on 2026-03-10 09:22–09:37 UTC affecting request latency and intermittent 503s for the Redwood Hosted API.
We have mitigated the issue and rolled back the configuration change that caused the regression. We believe your service may have experienced degraded performance.
If you were impacted, you may be eligible for an SLA credit. Our team will follow up with the exact credit amount within 48 hours and apply it automatically to your account. No action is required on your side.

Sorry for the disruption,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

matt (Product): Legal prefers "may be eligible" — keep as-is. lucy-legal: confirmed.

sylvie (Oncall): I'll post the status page update once billing confirms amounts. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-10-serve-latency

billing-ops: Computation complete. Sample entries:

```
acme-corp    impacted_minutes=15    monthly_commit_usd=10000    credit_usd=11.11
beta-inc     impacted_minutes=15    monthly_commit_usd=2000     credit_usd=2.22
```

billing-ops: We'll apply credits on next invoice and send a confirmation email to account owners. Will attach CSV to ticket.

jordan-se (Support): Copy of final customer message with credit line:

```
Hi Alice,

Following our earlier note, we have determined your account was impacted for ~15 minutes on 2026-03-10. Per your plan terms, we will apply a USD 11.11 credit to your next invoice. No action needed.

Thanks,
Jordan (Redwood Support)
```

sylvie (Oncall): Handing off monitoring to @ryan-oncall for the remainder of the shift. Leave incident open for postmortem and SLA feed.

ryan-oncall: taking over, will watch for regression. :eyes:

sylvie (Oncall): Thanks everyone — filing follow-up actions: postmortem, deploy gating for autoscaler changes, and billing reconciliation.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to 'Resolved — Monitoring'.
